display.purpose: Page/section headings and primary buttons. No eyebrow/kicker ever precedes it.

mono.purpose: Every instrument readout, advisory bulletin body, tables, tags, nav tabs — teletype-bulletin heritage, tabular numerals.

body.purpose: UI/body prose only; deliberately unobtrusive against the display + mono pairing.

shadows.name: rail-glow
shadows.purpose: Sticky instrument rail bottom edge, ties nav to the structural accent.

shadows.name: toast-lift
shadows.purpose: Separates the bottom-pinned level-up toast strip from page content.

motion.name: digit-roll
motion.purpose: Remount animation for any instrument readout (PressureGauge %) when its value refreshes; respects prefers-reduced-motion. Mechanically verified via computed-style probe; not yet visually confirmed in a screenshot (260ms transition).

motion.name: toast-slide
motion.purpose: LevelUpToast slide-in/out from the bottom viewport edge.

motion.name: gauge-fill
motion.purpose: PressureGauge arc fill transition on value change.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pressure-teal filled action button, Space Grotesk display type.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #3ecad9; color: #04141a; border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 11px 18px; font-weight: 700; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms ease, filter 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3ecad9; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Advisory Tag — Bullish
components.description: Severity-language pill for bullish bias; never compresses, wraps as a whole chip.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; border: 1px solid #232e3b; background: #161e29; white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0.01em; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-tag-bullish { color: #35d0a0; border-color: rgba(53,208,160,0.35); background: rgba(53,208,160,0.10); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Base surface unit: dark panel background, hairline border, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #10161f; border: 1px solid #232e3b; border-radius: 10px; padding: 20px 22px; min-width: 0; } .ds-panel h3 { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 6px; color: #e9eef3; } .ds-panel-sub { font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; color: #8b98a8; margin: 0; }

components.name: Instrument Rail (Nav)
components.description: Sticky top nav with SVG compass-rose wordmark, mono tabs, active-state tint.
components.html:
WealthAI

components.css: .ds-rail { position: sticky; top: 0; background: rgba(16,22,31,0.92); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border-bottom: 1px solid #232e3b; box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 0 rgba(15,76,86,0.4); } .ds-rail-inner { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; padding: 14px 20px; } .ds-wordmark { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; color: #e9eef3; } .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-tab { font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #8b98a8; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #e9eef3; background: #161e29; } .ds-tab-active { color: #3ecad9; border-color: rgba(62,202,217,0.3); background: rgba(62,202,217,0.08); }

components.name: PressureGauge
components.description: 270-degree instrument dial reading a 0-100 confidence/probability value, with digit-roll on refresh.
components.html: 70%BULLISH
components.css: .ds-gauge { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-gauge-value { margin-top: -57px; font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #35d0a0; display: block; animation: ds-digit-roll 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-gauge-label { font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #8b98a8; margin-top: -2px; } @keyframes ds-digit-roll { from { transform: translateY(35%); opacity: 0; } to { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-gauge-value { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview: WealthAI reads the market like a forecast-center meteorologist reads the atmosphere: every asset is a tracked system, every economic release is an advisory, and confidence is expressed as a forecast-cone width or an instrument-dial reading, never a bare percentage sitting alone. The world is a deep storm-slate situation board — cold blue-grey near-black, not a navy-purple "dark fintech" default — lit by one saturated pressure-teal that functions as the desk's own structural accent (rails, borders, active state, chart lines), not a decorative sprinkle. This was a deliberate refusal of the category-default trading-dashboard skin: WealthAI's positioning is showing its reasoning chain and never overstating certainty, and the visual world materializes that as an actual severity-tiered advisory language — bullish/bearish and hawkish/dovish read as weather-service colors (all-clear teal-green, warning red-orange, advisory amber, the pressure-teal family), with one reserved saturated crimson for the single most severe tier (shock-level geopolitical risk), rather than flat red/green.
keyCharacteristics: Deep storm-slate ground with one dominant structural accent (pressure-teal), not a multi-accent palette.
Advisory-severity color language stands in for bullish/bearish/hawkish/dovish, with a single reserved crimson for the most severe tier only.
Space Grotesk (display) / Space Mono (data and bulletin body) / Plus Jakarta Sans (UI prose) — a three-role type stack, each role used for its heritage, not decoratively.
Real instrument components (forecast-cone SVG, 270-degree pressure-gauge dial, labeled trajectory sparklines) replace flat bars, bare percentages, and decorative charts.
No eyebrows/kickers, no colored-border alerts, no bare sparklines — each banned in favor of a load-bearing alternative.

rules.name: The Severity-Not-Decoration Rule
rules.body: Every functional color (bullish/bearish/hawkish/dovish/severe) maps to a specific product meaning and must never be reassigned to a purely decorative role. --severe renders only the single most severe tier.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Pressure-teal is the only saturated non-functional accent. New UI reaches for the neutral/border scale before introducing a second decorative hue.

rules.name: The Single-Size Bulletin Rule
rules.body: Advisory bulletin body text never resizes for hierarchy — one size, ranked only by weight and case, matching real NOAA teletype bulletins.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: No eyebrow/kicker label ever sits above a page heading. Headings carry weight through h1-h3/.heading-block alone.

rules.name: The Contained-Overflow Rule
rules.body: Wide content never overflows the page horizontally; it scrolls inside its own explicitly-sized container, enforced at three layers (panel min-width:0, body overflow-x:hidden, .table-scroll opt-in).

rules.name: The Layered-Not-Lifted Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from stepped background tone (four steps: ground -> panel -> panel-alt -> raised) plus borders, not drop shadows.

dos: Do keep pressure-teal as the only saturated non-functional accent, carrying 40-50% of any surface via structural elements (borders, active states, chart lines), never as scattered decoration.
Do pair every sparkline/trend line with an explicit numeric label (delta + range), per MiniTrajectory.
Do route wide content (tables, wide charts) through a .table-scroll-style container with its own overflow-x: auto and an explicit min-width on the scrolling child.
Do keep short data tags white-space: nowrap + flex-shrink: 0; only long free-text chips override to wrap.
Do flag synthetic/heuristic data with the stamped bulletin pattern, at least as visibly as today, per PRODUCT.md's certainty constraints.
donts: Don't place an eyebrow/kicker label above a page heading — the pattern was removed app-wide; headings carry their own weight.
Don't use a colored border-left/right as an alert or disclosure device — the stamped bulletin tag replaced that pattern; a colored side-border is not part of this system.
Don't reassign --severe (crimson) to ordinary bearish/warning states — it is reserved for the single most severe tier only.
Don't ship a bare sparkline with no accompanying numeric label — sparklines are data readouts here, not decoration.
Don't introduce a second decorative accent hue alongside pressure-teal; reach for the neutral/border scale first.
